sar.narrative: The SAR concerns case HHG-002 involving a customer whose identity status is verified. A trigger was generated for transaction TXN-002 with a risk score of 0.85, indicating a high likelihood of illicit activity. The transaction occurred on the platform, though no specific date is provided. The analysis identified one device relationship linked to the customer and zero connected cards. A prior closed case, HIST-991, was found to have a fraud verdict for a card-not-present pattern and shares the same device profile. The shared device profile suggests a possible reuse of the same device in multiple fraudulent schemes. Consequently, the activity is deemed suspicious and warrants further investigation.
